incident.evidence_source: Parent-supplied sanitized execution metadata and local source trace only; no target, credentials, prompts, pages or saved run data accessed.
incident.observed: Discovery completed without an account bootstrap artifact or prepared identity pool; role-sensitive native execution lacked login session prerequisites.
incident.root_cause: Bootstrap was only an optional local planner suggestion; model decisions could skip it. No persisted login preparation dependency or native test dispatch guard existed. Task expansion treated nonempty account fields as an available session.

baseline_reproduction.check: manual credentials are logged in before a model can dispatch BOLA (1 worker)
baseline_reproduction.reason: Expected one persistent preparation task, found zero.

contracts.ordering: Web manual account scans persist deterministic login preparation after discovery; modeling, expansion and generated test tasks depend on it. Expansion requested early by discovery is deferred and executed deterministically after preparation, before workflow plans are persisted.
contracts.readiness: Tool registry requires the persisted preparation result and role-tagged session material bound to this scan; stored username/password alone is insufficient.
contracts.roles: BOLA requires attacker and victim; BFLA requires attacker and admin; other account-bound tests require attacker. Tool arguments cannot downgrade task roles.
contracts.outcomes: Preparation completion means the attempt/result was persisted. Closure state and human-input blockers remain explicit. Missing required sessions block test dispatch and prevent a successful overall run.
contracts.scope: Exact-origin login transport remains enforced. The cross-origin fixture observed zero requests at the undeclared destination.
contracts.reuse: Existing observed and supplied sessions, previous attempt results, and object fields are retained; no manual registration, credential generation, or automatic repeated failed login.
contracts.security_verdict: No finding or verified security verdict is inferred from preparation. Native baseline/mutation, object-context and finding evidence gates remain unchanged.
contracts.android: Web preparation is not inserted into Android acquisition.
contracts.compatibility: Both accounts and the existing identities alias receive the mandatory manual lifecycle and session gate.

validation_history.result: Added override-downgrade and observed-authenticated-endpoint cases; final full product suite 343/343.
The first test revision incorrectly read snapshot.findings; corrected to query the native findings table. No product change was needed for that fixture correction.
Added deterministic deferral for early expansion, fixed identities alias compatibility, and added BFLA privileged-role isolation coverage; final focused suite 20/20.

Final source: full product suite 345/345, focused identity suite 20/20, backend typecheck and normal build passed. Earlier frontend typecheck, mobile fixture 202/202, and automatic-account compatibility regression passed.

limitations: No live Web target, saved account, actual model, APK or Android runtime was exercised by this repair; full AI acceptance remains false.
HTTP forms and already-observed/supplied sessions are supported. Custom or JavaScript-only login still requires browser discovery/session capture or operator assistance; no login API is guessed.
Stored session material is not proof of token freshness, object ownership or a security finding. Downstream evidence gates remain authoritative.
No running process was restarted or modified; no remote push, deployment or CI was performed.
